basics.name: AHM Zafir Hasan
basics.title: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full stack developer trained through the IsDB-BISEW IT Scholarship Programme, building REST APIs and web applications with Node.js, C#/ASP.NET, SQL Server and MongoDB. Experienced with relational and NoSQL data modeling, token-based authentication and API testing, and currently serving as backend lead on a team capstone project.

experience.company: IsDB-BISEW IT Scholarship Programme | Star Computer Systems Limited
experience.role: Enterprise Software Engineering Trainee (Intensive Full-Time Diploma)
highlights: Intensive backend software engineering training focusing on Database Design & Implementation (MS SQL Server), Object-Oriented Programming (C#), Web APIs & Web Services, and Cloud Services (Azure).
Built practical proficiency in relational schema design, 3NF normalization, RESTful API architecture, JSON/XML data handling, CRUD operations, and Entity Framework Code-First data modeling.
Developed and maintained web applications and supported internal IT infrastructure; managed database updates and implemented technical solutions for client and internal workflows.
Collaborated with cross-functional corporate teams to execute analytical evaluations, data validation, and project coordination.

education.degree: Bachelor of Social Sciences (B.S.S. Hons) in Economics
highlights: Coursework in Econometrics, Mathematical Statistics, and Quantitative Data Analysis.
Professional diploma curriculum focusing on Full-Stack Software Engineering, Relational Database Systems, and Cloud Web APIs.

projects.name: TechNova E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Modular Node.js/Express backend with REST endpoints for authentication, product catalog, cart and cash-on-delivery orders, MongoDB data models and real-time WebSocket updates.
highlights: Architected a modular backend using Node.js & Express.js, implementing RESTful API endpoints for user authentication, product catalogs, shopping cart operations, and cash-on-delivery order processing.
Modeled document schemas and relational references using MongoDB & Mongoose (User, Product, Order collections); migrated persistent data storage from static JSON to MongoDB.
Implemented secure authentication with bcrypt password hashing and session validation; integrated WebSockets for real-time frontend updates and verified API payloads.

projects.name: Hyperlocal Skilled-Worker Booking Marketplace
projects.description: Backend lead designing REST API services for customer booking flows, service scheduling and provider profiles, working in a Git/GitHub team workflow.
highlights: Serving as backend lead designing RESTful API services for customer booking flows, service scheduling, and provider profiles.
Establishing API contracts, participating in daily standups, sprint planning, and managing the team repository on Git/GitHub with active peer code reviews.

projects.name: Supply Chain & Order Management REST API
projects.description: ASP.NET Web API handling master-detail data with full CRUD, EF migrations, token-based authentication, role-based access control and Postman test suites.
highlights: Engineered backend RESTful Web APIs handling master-detail data structures, executing complete CRUD operations and database migrations with Entity Framework.
Implemented token-based authentication and role-based access control; authored automated Postman test suites to validate endpoints, DTO contracts, and JSON responses.

projects.name: Power Plant Generation Database Architecture
projects.description: Normalized 3NF schema modeling monthly generation metrics, plant operations and fuel types, built from raw operational spreadsheets with enforced keys and integrity.
highlights: Designed a normalized 3NF relational database schema modeling monthly power generation metrics, plant operations, and fuel types based on real-world industrial specifications.
Transformed raw operational spreadsheets into structured SQL tables, enforcing primary/foreign keys and referential integrity for scalable data retrieval.
